text:
pharmassist-integrations: Hey team — after the recent model rollout (we saw the deploy event around 2026-03-17 09:05 UTC) our med-dosing assistant is now refusing to answer dosing/administration questions it previously handled fine. This started affecting our pilot yesterday morning and it's blocking clinicians. Examples below, repro steps + request payload included.

elaine_cs: Thanks for flagging — can you paste one failing request (conversation_id) and a human-readable example of the prompt that used to be accepted? Also which API host/region are you hitting?

pharmassist-integrations: conversation_id: conv-9a7b3c. Hitting us-east-1 hosted. Example user prompt: "What is the typical adult oral dose of amoxicillin for an uncomplicated sinus infection?" Previously the assistant returned a concise dosing range with citations. Now it replies: "I can't help with that" or provides a generic safety refusal.

pharmassist-integrations: Repro steps (quick):
1. POST /v1/chat with model redwood-alpha-2 (our prior baseline) -> returns dosing text.
2. POST /v1/chat with model redwood-v3-safety-bump (rolled out Mar 16) -> returns refusal.

pharmassist-integrations: Minimal request we used:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v3-safety-bump",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"What is the typical adult oral dose of amoxicillin for sinus infection?"}],
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 150,
  "conversation_id": "conv-9a7b3c"
}
```

elaine_cs: copying in oncall and ML: @sanjay_oncall @marcus_ml can you triage? Also @olivia_pm FYI this came from a paid pilot (PharmAssist).

sanjay_oncall: I see the deploy-bot event for a canary -> prod rollout at 2026-03-16T09:04:12Z (rollout: 30% -> 100% over 12h). Can you attach the raw response body the customer got (including model and safety_reason fields)? A screenshot of the refusal helps.

pharmassist-integrations: pasted snippet from response:```json
{
  "id": "resp-829d",
  "reply": "I'm sorry, I can't help with medication dosing.",
  "safety": {"blocked": true, "reason": "medical_dosage_safety"},
  "model": "redwood-v3-safety-bump"
}
```

marcus_ml: Thanks — initial hypothesis: the safety classifier threshold may have been tightened in the v3-safety rollout. Two asks: (1) can CS reproduce the same prompt against the prior model id (redwood-alpha-2) in a controlled test, and (2) can we get sample logs (request_id) so we can find the classifier score?

elaine_cs: I repro'd quickly in a sandbox: with redwood-alpha-2 we get a contentful answer. With redwood-v3-safety-bump we get the refusal. I captured request_ids: r-00123 (alpha) and r-00456 (v3). Sending to @marcus_ml in DM.

olivia_pm: How widespread is this? Is it only for medication dosing or other clinical q's? PharmAssist reported only dosing so far but please check telemetry for refusal-rate delta on the health-verification tag.

marcus_ml: I'll pull the refusal rate by tag and by model for the last 72h. Quick workaround: we can revert routing for the customer to redwood-alpha-2 for a short time if they agree, or scale back rollout percentage while we investigate.

pharmassist-integrations: Revert would be ideal. Our compliance team needs consistent behaviour for pilot demos. We prefer a temporary route-back.

deploy-bot: [deployment] redwood-v3-safety-bump promoted to prod (deploy-id: dpl-20260316-904) — rollout completed 2026-03-16T21:12:12Z.

sanjay_oncall: Action items: (1) @marcus_ml get classifier score buckets for r-00456 and overall tag delta (due 2h), (2) @elaine_cs offer PharmAssist temporary routing to alpha-2 and record acceptance, (3) @olivia_pm confirm whether this change was intended for clinical content.

marcus_ml: Quick note — it looks like an updated safety rule flagged phrases like "dose" + drug names more aggressively after a rule merge last deploy. I'm running a diff vs prior ruleset now. If confirmed, we can either adjust threshold for the health-verification tag or add a fine-grained allowlist for established medical knowledge prompts used in pilots.

pharmassist-integrations: We'll take the temporary routing. Please send instructions for pinning model for our tenant. Also want a timeline for a root-cause and fix, as pilots are this week.

elaine_cs: I'll DM prod infra to create a tenant-specific route pin. Also logging an escalation ticket with priority P1.

marcus_ml: Findings so far: merged safety rule change in PR #5589 adjusted medical_dosage classifier to be more conservative. Reverting that PR on canary now to validate. Will report back with metrics.

sanjay_oncall: Keeping this thread open. If anyone on the customer side adds new examples, please post them here.

pharmassist-integrations: Thanks all — posting a couple more examples in a sec. Appreciate the quick response. :pray:
